operator-walkthrough.ref: 2026-10-21 Billed card on the Today page (SalesCard). Nour sees six chips in order: Today, Yesterday, 7 days, 30 days, This month, Last month; 7 days is still the selected one on load. Tap Today on a normal morning, when the invoice mirror is current through yesterday: the card shows 'Not synced yet. The invoice mirror is current through <yesterday's date>.' and no dollar figure, no invoice count, no 'What this excludes' button (a $0 there would read as a dead shop). Tap Yesterday: the usual figure, 'N invoices · Yesterday' and the mirror line. Once the mirror reaches today, Today shows its real figure; a synced day with no invoices (a holiday) shows a real $0 with '0 invoices'. A failed read on either chip still shows 'Sales unreadable: this is UNKNOWN, not $0'. Other chips are unchanged. Also (Nour's choice, 2026-10-21, 'Refresh syncs anytime'): opening or refreshing /admin asks the server to sync ShopDriver, at most once per 30 minutes, any hour; when it starts, a small 'Syncing the invoice mirror from ShopDriver' line shows and the card re-reads every 15 s for up to 3 minutes, so a Today that read 'Not synced yet' turns into the figure by itself. Tapping chips or coming back to the page without a refresh does not sync again; each sync logs the shop counter out of ShopDriver, which Nour accepted. Evidence: client/src/__tests__/sales-card.test.tsx (day chips and the sync-once/poll behaviour; the whole file red before the change), server/shopSales.test.ts (day windows in America/New_York across 23:00/01:00 ET and both DST days, windowAfterThrough truth table, mocked-db read, router/service/card period parity; 29 red before the change) and server/lib/adminActivity.refreshSync.test.ts (31 min fires, 29 min does not, a plain admin touch never fires, one probe at a time, a failed probe stays out of the request, real elapsed time across both DST changes; mutation 'drop the 30 min check' turns 3 red).
